meta.name: modlens
meta.description: Plug-in vision for text-only models. Hard rule: when a file path or URL with an image extension (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .gif, .heic, .heif) appears anywhere in the conversation (typed by the user, injected as a `[Image: source: <path>]` line, or inside a tag) and you cannot see that image's content, run this skill on it before any other approach: no self-built OCR, no PIL, no tesseract. Also triggers on pasted-image placeholders such as `[Image #1]` and `[Unsupported Image]`. If you can actually see the image, do not use this skill. When unsure, run `modlens guard` before the first read of a session: a deny verdict means the active model has native vision and must read the image itself. Runs the modlens CLI to convert the image into structured JSON evidence: every word transcribed, layout regions, semantics, visual clues. Also use when the user asks how to install, configure, or switch modlens providers (Gemini API key, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Claude API or Claude Code CLI).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把图片转成文字给AI阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的AI助手看不见图片,而你常需要它处理图片
copy.tagline_en: Turn images into text for AI to read
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your AI assistant can't see images and you often need it to process them

howto.what: 装上后,当对话里出现图片路径/链接或图片占位符而你看不到图时,你会调用 modlens 把图转成结构化 JSON 证据:逐字转录、版块布局、语义和视觉线索,再据此回答。
howto.when: 当对话里出现带图片后缀的路径或网址(.png、.jpg 等)、或类似「[Image #1]」的占位符,而你看不到图时触发;用户询问安装、配置或切换 modlens 服务商时也会接管。

say.text: 帮我读这张图 /path/to/photo.png,把上面的文字列出来。
say.note: modlens 会把图片转成 JSON 再回答你。

say.text: 刚才我贴的截图里,标题和正文分别是什么?
say.note: 会定位对话里的图片占位符并读取。

say.text: 帮我配置 modlens,用 Gemini API 密钥。
say.note: 会按配置文档引导你设置服务商。

howto.what_en: When an image path/URL or placeholder appears and you cannot see it, this skill runs modlens to produce structured JSON evidence: transcribed text, layout regions, semantics, and visual clues, then answers from that.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an image path/URL or paste placeholder ('[Image #1]') appears and you cannot see the image; also when the user asks to install/configure/switch modlens providers.

say_en.text: Read this image /path/to/photo.png and list the text in it.
say_en.note: modlens converts it to JSON before answering.

say_en.text: In the screenshot I just pasted, what are the heading and body?
say_en.note: It locates the pasted-image placeholder and reads it.

say_en.text: Set up modlens with my Gemini API key.
say_en.note: It walks you through provider configuration.
